Notifications

Three transport-neutral contracts, e-mail, messaging and real time, each with its providers: SMTP and Twilio, Azure Service Bus, and Azure SignalR.

Packages

Package What it does Builds on
Notification.Mail Abstraction library for email notifications in .NET applications. —
Notification.Mail.Smtp SMTP implementation for NuvTools.Notification.Mail using MailKit and MimeKit. Notification.Mail
Notification.Mail.Twilio Twilio Email API implementation for NuvTools.Notification.Mail. Notification.Mail
Notification.Messaging Abstraction library for building messaging solutions in .NET applications. —
Notification.Messaging.Azure.ServiceBus Azure Service Bus implementation for NuvTools.Notification.Messaging. Notification.Messaging
Notification.Realtime Abstraction library for real-time notifications in .NET applications. —
Notification.Realtime.Azure.SignalR Azure SignalR server-side implementation for NuvTools.Notification.Realtime. Notification.Realtime
Notification.Realtime.Azure.SignalR.Client Azure SignalR client-side implementation for receiving real-time notifications. —
